How it works

From login to live TV in a minute

  1. 1

    Add your playlist

    Type the login from your TV provider, paste a link, pick a file, enter a MAC portal, or connect Plex, Jellyfin or Emby. On a TV, scan a code and type it on your phone instead.

  2. 2

    Tuned keeps it on the device

    Channels, the guide, films and shows are saved on the device and refreshed in the background, so the app opens straight to them.

  3. 3

    Watch anywhere

    On the phone, a tablet, Android TV, or cast to the big screen. Your login stays encrypted on the device.

A closer look

Clean, quick, and out of your way

Every screen is made to get you watching. No pop-ups, no clutter, and nothing waits on the network.

Live TV

Every channel, and what's on now

Your channels open at once from the device, with the programme on now and how far through it is. Flip to the full grid guide, filter by sport, quality or what's on now, or type a channel number on the remote. Filters stay until you change them.

  • Grid guide, reminders and live events
  • Pause, rewind and record — live or from the guide
  • The same guide on the web, with a click that opens VLC

Movies and shows

A real library, not a list of links

Posters, ratings, summaries and trailers, real episode names instead of S1 E1, sort by newest or rating, actor pages, and Continue watching across everything.

  • Skip intro, next episode and Watch later
  • Download a film or a whole season for the plane
  • Trakt and Simkl, with Trakt history import

The player

Just the picture, until you tap

The player starts fast and shows only video. A tap brings the time, the stream's details and the tools, each its own button: cast, record, channels, quality, fit and lock.

  • Captions styled your way, and subtitle search
  • Cast to Chromecast and DLNA, phone as the remote
  • Mini player on Back, picture-in-picture and background play

Android TV

Made for the remote

The same app on Android TV and Google TV, with clear focus, cinematic show pages, Movies and Shows that use the whole screen, and a calibrate tool for overscan. Sign in by scanning a code with your phone instead of typing with the remote.

  • Calibrate screen, dark by default, Tuned's own keyboard
  • Matches the TV to the video's frame rate
  • Your playlists and settings follow you with a Tuned account

For the whole home

Everyone gets their own

Up to six profiles, each with its own favourites, history and picture. Kids profiles and PINs keep the right things in front of the right people, and widgets put favourite channels on the home screen.

Features

Everything in Tuned

All 70 features, in one place. Tuned is customizable too: most of what it does has a setting, with the common choice already picked.

Bring your playlist

  • Xtream Codes logins
    A server address, username and password, read through the Xtream API when a provider blocks the M3U.
  • M3U links and files
    Any M3U or M3U8 link, or a file on the device, with its XMLTV guide.
  • MAC portals
    Sign in to a Stalker portal with the MAC address your provider registered.
  • Plex, Jellyfin and Emby
    Add a home media server for Live TV, films and shows, with the server's own guide when it has one.
  • Several playlists Premium
    Keep as many playlists as you like and switch between them.
  • Switch back instantly
    Jump to a recent playlist without waiting on a full download again.
  • Kept fresh in the background
    Channels and the guide refresh on a schedule, on Wi-Fi only if you like.
  • Real progress while it loads
    Numbered steps, bytes when the size is known, and about how much longer once Tuned can tell.
  • Countries and languages
    Hide the countries, languages and channel groups you never watch.
  • Guide fixes
    Move a channel's times, add extra guide links, or pick a channel's guide entry.
  • Playlists and settings on the web Premium
    Manage them at tunedplayer.com from a browser; the app joins the backup with its own.

Questions

Good to know

Does Tuned come with channels?

No. Tuned is a player: it plays the playlist from your own TV provider or home media server, through an Xtream Codes login, an M3U link or file, a MAC portal, or Plex, Jellyfin or Emby. It doesn't sell or include any channels.

Is it free?

Yes. Tuned is free, with no ads. Tuned Premium is an optional upgrade for the extras marked Premium in the list above.

Which devices does it run on?

Android phones and tablets on Android 8.0 or later, and Android TV and Google TV. Samsung TV, iPhone, iPad and Mac apps are coming soon.

How do I install it?

On a phone or tablet, tap Download for Android, open the file, and allow installs from your browser when Android asks. On Android TV or Google TV, install the free Downloader app from the TV's app store, type tunedplayer.com/download into it, and allow it to install apps. The Android TV guide has every step. After that Tuned offers each new version itself.

Is my login safe?

Your login is encrypted on the device and stays there until you sign out. It never goes in the app's log. If you turn on a Tuned account, its backup carries your playlists to your other devices.

Will it get my account blocked for streaming twice?

Tuned only ever opens one stream connection. The old stream closes before the next opens, nothing loads ahead, and downloads wait while you watch.
